Inline Image Size Check

This document tests whether an inline raster <img> embedded directly inside a flowing paragraph (not wrapped in a block-level <figure>, as picture.html does) is detected as a picture region at all, using a larger (300x180px, same size as the SVG in picture.html) image to rule out the small-image-in-kitchen_sink result being a size artifact. Here it is inline: right in the middle of this sentence, followed by more text after the image to confirm the paragraph continues flowing around/after it.
